_readme: A night at the inn, and the loop the whole economy rests on: fight, lose hit points,
The route is long on purpose. This session has to arrive at the counter WOUNDED, and
the only window in this game where the player is neither full at the start nor
refilled by a level-up is straight after the first slink - one fight worth 5xp against
a curve that levels at 10. So the opening legs are the walkthrough's own, verbatim,
as far as that fight; everything after it is the walk home.
That fight also drops exactly four gold, which is exactly what a night costs. Asserting
a full bar after a rest would prove nothing at all - it is the 14 BEFORE it that makes
Every leg is held until a wall, a body or the water stops it. The town's are the
fussiest: the carter patrols the column between the plaza and the inn, so the walk
north up her column may end a row early - which is why nothing downstream depends on
the row, only on the column.

steps.text: the title opens the game now. A --qa-script run points saves at user://qa_saves and empties it at boot, so there is never anything to Continue - and the cursor opens on the row a press will actually do something with, which is New game. Rows: Continue, New game. One press starts the run.
the warden opens the game now - hear her out before anything else
the village, carrying nothing and owed an explanation

fetch Rook first: since M29 both roads out of the village refuse a player travelling alone, because everything past them is sized for two. South until the water stops us, west to the wall, south until SHE stops us.

north up the wall and through the west door, which opens now that she is along. The warden's conversation and the barred keep gate both moved out of this script - talk_to_npc still walks the first, and the_road_needs_two walks every locked door in the game, including the two this milestone added.
south down the east side until the wall, then west into the pair standing in the gap
beaten, and its body is gone from the gap

hp AFTER a fight that did not level anyone - the only window in this script where it is neither full at the start nor refilled by a level-up, and so the only place a change to the damage arithmetic is visible at all. 18 rather than 14 because the fight is a PAIR now: two slinks each take a turn, and the enemy draws its target across the party, so the leader eats less of it than he did alone
and the first xp assertion in this script - assert_level cannot see xp, because three different totals all read as level 3. The award sums the formation: 5 and 5
and the coin that fight dropped - asserted HERE because before it the purse is zero whether drops work or not
out of the hollow: north until the water stops us, east to the wall, one south onto the door
the village, anchored the whole way: the bush at [2,8] stops the walk south, the water stops the walk east, then the south wall - and the bottom row runs onto the town gate

the town. The carter patrols the column between the plaza and the inn, so this takes the long way round and never counts a tile until it has a wall to count from: bottom row, west to the water, north up her column (she may stop us early - the column is what matters, not the row), west wall, north wall
row 1 carries a bush at [2,1], so drop to row 2 and let the INN'S OWN west wall stop us - the building we are walking to is the anchor
one south, two east, and the door is directly overhead
inside. The keeper stands on the door's own column, so north until a body stops us

what a night is being bought WITH: four gold, and eighteen of twenty hit points. The hp is the whole point of asserting here - it was read after a fight that did not level anyone, so it is neither full at the start nor refilled by a level-up, and a rest that quietly did nothing would be invisible against a full bar
the first choice is the room; pressing through takes it
and the night itself - an overlay, so the player cannot walk out of a fade
morning: full, and four gold lighter
and again, with nothing in the purse. The keeper says so and the night never comes - if the price stopped being checked, this would be a second free night and the state below would read 'resting'
